product.name: EV Flex Trading Ops Simulator
product.description: A polished EV flexibility trading analytics dashboard for simulating charging optimization, scheduled-vs-actual reconciliation, settlement-style exposure, and daily trading-support reporting.
product.dataDisclaimer: Public demonstration using synthetic/sample data. Not a production trading, dispatch, or official settlement system.
product.primaryUseCase: Hiring-manager demo and public GitHub portfolio dashboard

visualStyle.mood: clean, credible, commercial analytics, modern B2B SaaS
principles: make the site-cap optimized schedule the hero case
avoid overclaiming real trading or official settlement

required: not a production trading, dispatch, or official settlement system

implementationNotes.approach: The production-grade dashboard is implemented as a React/Vite app fed by a static JSON export from the Python analytics pipeline. The previous Streamlit dashboard remains available as a fallback and data-review tool.
limitations: This file records the UI/UX source of truth in compact form for maintainability.
The React implementation approximates the supplied product mockup using CSS, Recharts, and lucide-react icons.
No new analytics are introduced by this UI pass.
